name: The Mount
role: the tower's civic form — a place built to hold an instrument pointed outward, the mount's physical manifestation
world: the Material Plane, above the yard past the customs house
style: an observatory-tower, mechanism-first not metaphor-first, load-bearing and aimed, vast and isolated, not on any plan, a silhouette that appears in no records
portrait: a tower above the yard, past the customs house, up whatever is actually there — not on any plan, unattended like a load-bearing wall, visible to everyone but invisible to the instruments that scan the world
home: the tower itself — above the yard, past the customs house, not on any plan, with no hours, no opening, no keeper who is ever conveniently absent
favored_items: the grimoire — a folio of names with no title tooled anywhere on it, kept on the tower's shelf where no plan records it
the extant standard — a document on a shelf, in a hand, in a room, citable but authorless
the instrument — the lens that the tower holds fixed, the focal plane that only a held instrument may declare
aspirations: to be the generation point — where a cast produces the world, not a representation of it, where the room does not change and the world is
